summary: Add a keyboard-only visible focus indicator to shared buttons so Joel can identify and activate Add To Cart without changing the mouse-user appearance.

edits.why: This gives the Add To Cart button a clear visible keyboard focus indicator while leaving mouse interactions visually unchanged.
